title: Owner browser check: Spotify stays playable past the hour and reconnects only for a dead grant (RF-216)
acceptance: On desktop Chrome with Spotify Premium, against a production build that includes RF-216: (1) leave Ritmo and Spotify unused for at least 65 minutes, then open a Spotify-only class: Music and Connections show Spotify Connected, Live preflight passes and Start class is audible within a few seconds with no Reconnect prompt; (2) run a class across the hour mark from the last Spotify use and confirm music keeps playing through it; (3) remove Ritmo in Spotify's account 'Manage apps', then Start a Spotify class: Ritmo asks to reconnect Spotify. Retryable failures (Spotify 5xx/429, network) are proved by tests only; they cannot be forced on production.
nextAction: RF-216 is deployed (main eaddb1da, Worker a12d0e73, 2026-11-12). Owner: run the three steps on desktop Chrome with Spotify Premium and record the result here. Step 3 removes Ritmo from Spotify's Manage apps, so reconnect Spotify afterwards.
